paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Mom gave Tom a small list and some money. "Please go to the pharmacy in town and buy a tube of cream for Dad's hands," she said. "After that, you have two hours for yourselves." Tom and Lily took the bus, and Pip stayed at home with Mom.

"Let's go to the pharmacy first," said Lily. "Then we will not forget the cream." "Good idea," said Tom, "because after that we are free." "Shall we go to the exhibition at the town library?" asked Lily. "It has photos of runners from our town, and it is free." "Yes, let's go," said Tom. "I run every morning, and I want to become a fast runner."

At the pharmacy, a woman in a white coat gave Tom the cream. The price was ninety baht, and Tom counted his money carefully. Next to the pharmacy, there was a small shop with a window full of headphones. "Shall we look at the headphones?" asked Tom. "My old headphones are broken." "I think you must wait," said Lily, "because the new ones cost too much." "You have only a little money, and Mom needs the cream." "I only want to see them," said Tom with a smile.

The shop man showed them a pair of green headphones. The price on the box was six hundred baht. Tom put the box back on the shelf. "Not today," he said. "I will wait and keep my money." "That is a good plan," said Lily. "Let's go to the exhibition now."

The exhibition was in a quiet room on the first floor of the town library. A sign on the door said, "NO PHOTOS, PLEASE." "We cannot take photos here," said Lily. "I will write notes for the blog." On the walls, there were big photos of runners on the old town trail and in the park. Tom stopped at a photo of a girl at the end of a long race. She was tired, but she was smiling. "I like this photo because she did not stop," said Tom.

On the bus home, Tom held the bag with the cream. "Let's run in the park tomorrow," he said. "Shall we ask Mia?" asked Lily. "Yes, she is a good runner, and she likes the park." "Then I can write about all of us on the blog," said Lily. At home, Pip ran to the door and smelled the bag.
